obligations.expected_behavior: Detached positive Probes execute as real independent processes using bound inputs and producing bound outputs.
forbidden_result: Positive Probes execute in-process or without bound inputs or outputs.
Probe behavior is inferred from metadata or another non-process surrogate.
obligations.observable_result: Each detached positive Probe has independent process execution with bound input and output evidence.
obligations.state_after: Positive Probes have independently executed process results with bound input/output evidence.
obligations.state_before: Independent process execution and input/output binding for positive Probes are not yet established.
obligations.subject: Detached positive Probes
obligations.trigger: When a detached positive Probe is run.
